parsed.name: 是德科技 UXRxxx4A 四通道示波器
parsed.description: 用于控制与读取是德科技 UXRxxx4A/UXRxxx4AP 四通道示波器的高速示波测量设备，可用于实验中的波形采集、信号观察与自动量测。
parsed.description_en: A high-performance oscilloscope used to control and read a Keysight UXRxxx4A/UXRxxx4AP 4-channel oscilloscope for waveform acquisition, signal observation, and automated measurements in laboratory experiments.
